title: Rear-End Collision: Insurer Ignored Police Report on Liability
description: Meridian Auto Insurance assigned the claimant 50% comparative negligence in a rear-end collision, directly contradicting the responding officer's police report, which found the other driver 100% at fault. The insurer also undervalued the repair estimate against an independent body-shop quote.

recipient.name: Meridian Auto Insurance Co. - Appeals Department

facts.liabilityFinding: Comparative negligence: claimant found 50% at fault for the rear-end collision.
facts.policeReportFinding: Officer M. Diaz found the other driver 100% at fault for following too closely.
facts.independentEstimateSource: Sunrise Collision Center, written estimate dated 2026-02-20
facts.coverageFinding: Collision coverage, Policy Section 4.2, subject to comparative-negligence offset.
